name: Hand of Horzasha
source:
When a headstrong knight from the sealed-off human world witnesses the neglect of an orphaned child, she abandons her former life as an explorer to protect her newly adopted daughter in life-risking ritual combat in a strange town of monsters. Let our search for "Horzasha" begin!

Hand of Horzasha is a visual novel set in a town of monsters. Forge bonds with the townsfolk as you solve local mysteries and face off in high-stakes disputes. As you unravel the secrets of the Gibal Valley, your choices will reflect the public's opinion of your actions. Once per month, you have a chance to stay in town free of charge or be evicted and left to survive in a perilous wilderness. 

Hand of Horzasha places you in the shoes of Diala Joulsae, an explorer sent by the human world to map out uncharted lands. Upon arriving, she is beset by local wildlife when a race of people called the Meire come to her rescue. Sheltering Diala in their idyllic village, the Meire show her their way of life and offer her refuge in exchange for labor. Stranded for the time being, Diala agrees. But after meeting Aurelia, an unattended orphan who is ignored by all, Diala finds a new reason to put her journey on hold. What happens next will change her life irreversibly.

Players will discover a cast of unusual characters, almost none of whom are human. In order to keep staying in the village and unraveling its mysteries, Diala will need to be on good terms with the seven powerful families who rule Randall Village. They will vote at the end of each month on whether to continue sheltering or to evict their refugee residents, whom they call "Lessers." With the help of others in her position, Diala will endure many hardships in order to uncover the truth, including the dreaded trial spoken of only in whispers: "Obosolph."

[From [url=https://shinyvacation.itch.io/hand-of-horzasha]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名来自与世隔绝的人类世界、意志坚定的女骑士目睹一名孤儿遭到忽视，于是放弃探险家的生活，在一个怪物城镇的危及生命的仪式战斗中保护自己收养的女儿。让我们开始寻找“Horzasha”吧！

《Horzasha之手》是一部以怪物城镇为舞台的视觉小说。与镇民建立羁绊，解决当地谜团，在高风险争端中对峙。随着你揭开吉巴尔谷的秘密，你的选择将反映公众对你行为的看法。每月一次，你有机会免费留在镇上，也可能被驱逐，独自面对危险的荒野。

玩家将扮演迪亚拉·朱尔赛，一名受人类世界派遣、负责绘制未知土地地图的探险家。抵达后，她遭到当地野生动物袭击，名为迈雷的族群前来救她。迈雷把迪亚拉带到理想乡般的村庄，让她了解自己的生活方式，并以劳动换取庇护。暂时无处可去的迪亚拉同意了。但她遇见被所有人忽视、无人照料的孤儿奥蕾莉亚后，找到了暂停旅程的新理由。接下来发生的事情，将永远改变她的人生。

玩家会遇见一群不寻常的角色，他们几乎没有人类。为了继续留在村庄并揭开谜团，迪亚拉需要与统治兰德尔村的七个强大家族保持良好关系。每月底，他们会投票决定继续庇护还是驱逐被称为“低等人”的难民居民。在同类的帮助下，迪亚拉将经历重重困难，揭开真相，其中包括一个只在低声耳语中提及、令人恐惧的审判：“奥博索尔夫”。

[来源：[url=https://shinyvacation.itch.io/hand-of-horzasha]itch.io[/url]]
